observations.body: At Beersheba God addresses Israel’s fear, promises a great nation and return, and places Joseph at Jacob’s deathbed.

payload.posture: Read Genesis 46:1–7 as one movement in Joseph's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states at Beersheba God addresses Israel’s fear, promises a great nation and return, and places Joseph at Jacob’s deathbed. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Joseph's story.
